method: Independent radial finite-element calculation; NOT native ANSYS output

char_law.notes: Nominal chamber pressure is 800 +/- 200 psi. The pressure is now explicit, but gas composition and oxidation kinetics remain exploratory and require calibration before predictive use.

provenance.pressure: User estimate 800 psi; interpreted as absolute for inherited char closure
provenance.thermal_environment: Previous v0, Tg=2504 K, h0=1000 W/m2/K, exploratory
provenance.cf_k: Woven carbon/epoxy surrogate: Joven et al., Thermal properties of carbon fiber-epoxy composites with different fabric weaves (2011), in-plane 2-3 and thickness 0.5-0.6 W/m/K
provenance.cf_cp: Tranchard et al. Materials 2017 10(5)494 Table 5 virgin T700/M21 fit; clamp at 200 C; surrogate, not actual fabric
provenance.case_temperature_limit: 150 C CF / 300 C Al are model-range flags only, not certified failure temperatures
provenance.exposure: Uniform liner exposure from ignition assumed; pilot only
provenance.sensitivity: Factor-two perturbation of uncalibrated effective removal cost; not measured kinetic uncertainty

qualification: Exploratory surrogate, not physically calibrated; property threshold is not structural failure
